messages.en: Bring your ID card and a copy of that certificate tomorrow, okay? I've already printed the form.
Okay, I've already put everything in my bag.
Do you want to enter this competition too?
Yeah! I signed up yesterday. Let's enter together.

collocations.en: go back to one's hometown once in a while

messages.en: We can eat out once in a while, can't we? I've been cooking every day.
Let's go, then. Shall we just go to that place near our house?

senses.en_definition: An unspecified person; any individual when speaking generally.

messages.en: There's someone in the lobby who wants to see you. I don't know them.
Oh, it might be the person coming to pick up that document. Could you quickly ask their name?
His name is Mr Rahman. He says he has an appointment with you at ten.
